key_insight: Higher-order QMC–Galerkin finite element analysis yields error bounds independent of parameter dimension and the singular perturbation parameter ε.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports reliable uncertainty quantification for reaction–diffusion models with small ε, where sharp boundary layers challenge standard discretizations.
method: Establish ε-uniform stability and mixed-parametric regularity in an ε-weighted energy norm.
Combine dimension truncation and higher-order QMC integration with robust finite element approximation.
Verify the spatial approximation property in 1D using piecewise affine elements on Shishkin meshes.
evidence_signal: Theoretical error estimates are complemented by numerical experiments illustrating the predicted robustness and convergence rates.
watch_item: The fully discrete guarantee assumes ε-robust spatial approximation, verified here only for a one-dimensional model problem.
paper_title: Higher-Order QMC Galerkin FEM for Singular Perturbation: Reaction-Diffusion with Affine-Parametric Reaction
